name: Peyton's Post-Op Visits
source:
It's been three years since Peyton last saw his old roommate from university when he learns that he's just had top surgery, and that he's transgender, just like him. He doesn't know how long it's been since Marcus came out, or what's been going on in his life since then, or even why they haven't spoken in so long, but... it's worth a try, isn't it? To reconnect.

[From [url=https://littlerat.itch.io/peytons-post-op-visits]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
佩顿上次见到他大学时的老室友已经三年了，当时他得知自己刚刚做了顶级手术，而且自己和他一样是跨性别者。他不知道Marcus出来已经有多久了，也不知道从那以后他的生活发生了什么事，甚至不知道为什么他们这么久都没有说话，但是……值得一试，不是吗？重新连接。

[来自[url=https://littlerat.itch.io/peytons-post-op-visits]itch.io[/url]]
